title: Nedre Romerike
extracted_sentences: Nedre Romerike is the lower (southern) part of the Romerike traditional district in Akershus, Norway.
It consists of the municipalities Lillestrom, Lorenskog, Nittedal, Raelingen and Aurskog-Holand.
It make up the area served by Nedre Romerike District Court, based in Lillestrom.
The upper (northern) half of Romerike is known as Ovre Romerike   .
